title: Structural log members.
officialText:
Stress grading of structural log members of nonrectangular shape, as typi-
cally used in log buildings, shall be in accordance with ASTM D 3957. Such structural log members shall be
identified by the grade mark of an approved lumber grading or inspection agency. In lieu of a grade mark on the
material, a certificate of inspection as to species and grade issued by an approved lumber grading or inspection
agency shall be permitted.
